name: Roger Williams
bio: Roger Williams (1604–1683) is represented in this archive by verse from Burton E. Stevenson's anthology Poems of American History (1908; revised 1922).

Poems of American History gathers verse on events from the Norse voyages to the Spanish-American War, arranged by historical chapter. The poem here is “God Makes a Path”; Stevenson's editorial headnotes are not reproduced.

poems.title: God Makes a Path
poems.author: Roger Williams
poems.text:
God makes a path, provides a guide,
  And feeds in wilderness!
His glorious name while breath remains,
  O that I may confess.

Lost many a time, I have had no guide,
  No house, but hollow tree!
In stormy winter night no fire,
  No food, no company:

In him I found a house, a bed,
  A table, company:
No cup so bitter, but's made sweet,
  When God shall sweetning be.
